quality_guards: Rabies risk depends on country, animal species, exposure route, wound characteristics, prior vaccination, product authenticity and treatment delay.
Rabies evidence is exposure-, animal-, country-, patient-, treatment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Q-fever risk depends on animal infection status, birthing materials, aerosol generation, occupation, proximity, immune status and environmental conditions.
Q-fever evidence is animal-, holding-, activity-, person-, exposure- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Plague risk depends on travel destination, rodent or flea exposure, clinical syndrome, laboratory evidence, contact history and response timing.
Plague evidence is traveller-, exposure-, case-, laboratory-, jurisdiction- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Anthrax risk depends on spore source, exposure route, dose, animal or product history, work activity, susceptibility and treatment timing.
Anthrax evidence is animal-, product-, environment-, person-, laboratory- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Woodworking risk depends on machine type, cutter, feed method, guarding, extraction, material, maintenance and operator competence.
Woodworking evidence is machine-, task-, safeguard-, operator-, material- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Pressure-system risk depends on fluid, pressure, volume, temperature, design, protective devices, deterioration, maintenance and operating conditions.
Pressure-system evidence is equipment-, fluid-, duty-, examination-, maintenance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Welding-fume risk depends on process, metal, coating, consumable, duration, ventilation, control performance, respiratory protection and worker susceptibility.
Welding-fume evidence is process-, task-, workplace-, control-, worker- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level disease probability.
Enclosed-space risk depends on space geometry, cargo or residues, atmosphere, isolation, ventilation, adjacent work, entry controls and rescue readiness.
Enclosed-space evidence is vessel-, space-, atmosphere-, task-, crew- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fatality probability.
Aircraft-icing risk depends on aircraft certification, cloud and precipitation, temperature, contamination, flight phase, equipment, procedures and crew decisions.
CAA icing evidence is aircraft-, operation-, weather-, contamination-, crew- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level accident probability.
Level-crossing risk depends on crossing type, train frequency and speed, road or pedestrian use, visibility, behaviour, controls and maintenance.
Level-crossing evidence is crossing-, route-, user-, traffic-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collision probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
